Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_reading: The scenario suffix 120 is Syndra's splinter option at its cap: the cached passive text caps Splinters of Wrath at 120 and grants Transcendence (+15% AP) exactly at 120. Every Transcendent threshold is therefore active in this scenario: 40 (Q second charge), 60 (W true damage), 80 (E), 100 (R execute), 120 (AP buff).
independent_computation.step_2_castable_slots: At splinters >= 40 the cached Q text stocks 'a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2', so two Q casts are legal back-to-back from stocked charges (charge-based, not gated by the 7 s recharge). The opening therefore contains FIVE castable ability slots, not four: Q, Q(second charge, the module's synthetic Q2 slot per data/champion-audit/batch-6.json), W, E, R.
independent_computation.step_3_setup_consume_edge: R is a sphere CONSUMER: 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones'. Verified against the leveling rows: Minimum / per-sphere = 240/80 = 360/120 = 480/160 = 3.0 and (60/20)=3.0 AP-ratio, i.e. the floor is exactly the 3 self-conjured spheres. Maximum / per-sphere = 560/80 = 840/120 = 1120/160 = 7.0 and (140/20)=7.0, i.e. the ceiling is exactly 3 conjured + 4 grabbed = 7 spheres. R's damage is therefore strictly increasing in the number of LIVE spheres on the ground at cast time, so every sphere-creating cast (Q, and Q's second charge) must precede R.
independent_computation.step_4_timing_feasibility: Sphere lifetime is 6 s ('remains on the ground for 6 seconds'). Cast times: Q and W instant (castTime 'none'), E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s, so five casts on the one shared timeline (docs/math-foundations.md 1.1: one set of hands, greedy by cast order) complete in ~1-1.5 s, far inside the 6 s window. Both Q spheres are alive when R fires at index 4, so the setup is real, not nominal.
independent_computation.step_5_value_of_the_edge: At R rank 3, R with the two Q spheres pre-placed grabs 5 spheres: 5 x (160 + 20% AP) = 800 + 100% AP. R fired before them takes the 3-sphere floor: 480 + 60% AP. Delta = 320 + 40% AP raw magic damage lost by casting R too early - a first-order error, not a rounding one.
independent_computation.step_6_index_arithmetic: cast_timeline[4] is the 5th cast. With exactly five castable slots in the opening and R required last by the setup/consume edge above, slot(cast_timeline[4]) = R. The old value Q at index 4 can only arise from a four-slot cycle (Q, W, E, R then Q again), i.e. a timeline that either drops the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge or repeats Q after R - and in either arrangement R lands at index <= 3, firing at fewer live spheres than the scenario's own splinter state makes available. A cast-timeline that puts a Q AFTER R also violates the cooldown/renewal picture in docs/math-foundations.md 1.1 in spirit: that trailing sphere arrives too late to be grabbed and contributes nothing to R.
independent_computation.conclusion: R is the correct slot at cast_timeline[4] for syndra_custom_order_120.

caveats: The golden scenario definition lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/), so the scenario's literal cast-order input was never read. The computation above is grounded only in cached wiki text (data/champions.json), the cached audit facts about which slots exist (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json, batch-e9-1.json), and the scheduling semantics quoted from docs/math-foundations.md.

The audit cache notes R prices spheres from a user-set r_spheres option rather than from the live sphere count, so the ordering claim here is about the cast timeline's correctness as a rotation, not about R's damage number in this scenario.

Old value Q at index 4 would only be defensible if the scenario's custom order deliberately lists a post-R Q at position 5; nothing in the permitted evidence supports that, and it would be a strictly dominated rotation given the 3-vs-7 sphere arithmetic above.
